recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It repairs the linked summary-level worked example without changing the broader reporting model; CQI can separately decide whether to add more individual or subject-list supplemental-data examples.
issue_request: FHIR-20195 was an Applied/Persuasive CQI issue raised against STU3 and applied for R4. It requested a worked MeasureReport example showing how supplemental data is communicated as Observations.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-20195. Historical commit ca11697531 added the Quality Reporting topic link to the CMS146 Measure and MeasureReport examples while clarifying supplemental-data reporting, and the CMS146 example narrative contained supplemental rows. The current XML resource, however, lacked MeasureReport.supplementalData references and contained Observation resources.
additional_context: Later CQI issues FHIR-29807, FHIR-29816, FHIR-34495, and FHIR-37559 refined the supplemental-data model. FHIR-37559 added the current MeasureReport.supplementalData element and guidance that summary reports use contained Observations to count each supplemental-data value. A 2021 Zulip thread reported confusion about the CMS146 supplemental-data example and the lack of concrete MeasureReport guidance.
reconciliation: Added contained Observation resources for the CMS146 gender and deceased supplemental-data counts to source/measurereport/measurereport-cms146-cat3-example.xml, and added MeasureReport.supplementalData references to those contained resources.
source_changes: source/measurereport/measurereport-cms146-cat3-example.xml: added contained Observation resources for gender/deceased supplemental-data counts and referenced them from MeasureReport.supplementalData.

related_jiras.note: Clarified that supplemental data may be represented as resources and non-resource values can use Observation resources.
Recorded the same supplemental-data clarification for Measure.supplementalData.
Refined the supplemental-data definition and kept MeasureReport/Quality Reporting as the place for details.
Introduced the current MeasureReport.supplementalData element and summary-report guidance used by this example fix.
